title: The token panel
description: How the token panel opens, saves and forgets. Saving or forgetting the token in use reloads the page, so that every request is made again with it.

states.description: Not shown. The bar's Tokens button shows only once a repository is open and at least one token is kept; it reads 'Token added' when one covers this repository and 'Tokens' when none does.

Under the bar at the right: the tokens kept, each with its scope, 'in use' on the one this repository uses, where it is kept (this tab or this browser) and Forget; what kind of token the host wants and that it goes to that host alone; a password field; 'Use it for' with every repository on the host, everything under each owner or group, or only this repository; 'Keep it on this browser after the tab closes'; Save and reload, and Cancel.
The page reloads to read the repository again with the token now in force.

transitions.trigger: the Tokens button, or Add a token on the status line
transitions.action: the token field takes the focus; an owner or group is chosen as the scope unless a token is already in use

transitions.trigger: Cancel, Escape, the Tokens button, or a click outside the panel
Save and reload, or Enter in the field
transitions.action: the token replaces any other for that scope, in this tab or, if asked, this browser

transitions.guard: it is the token in use

transitions.action: the list is drawn again without it
